name: Hanabusa Jirou
source:
Shoukei Academy French teacher.
He often sprinkles meaningless french into conversations, but he is full-blooded Japanese.
A bright and optimistic person, but his eccentric actions can sometimes bring his surroundings into chaos.
He has a strong sense of justice and hates twisted things. Friendly to pigeons.
